records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the note -- a busy week makes total sense, and it looks like you've already got your first project going. Nice start. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so that's the right place to build from.

When you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your next step with you.

Best,
Nadia
